payload.title: record_human_required uses the request id as the record's file name with no check, two producers mint ids containing a colon (self-change:<digest> and tool-degraded:<tool>:<cycle>), and both lanes' forensic uploads exclude only human-required/genesis:*, so the first such record turns the Cache ARIA state tree step red in every sealed run while the record exists (latent)
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/human_required.py:86-87 (the file name is f'{request_id}.json', colon kept)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/human_required.py:180-186 (record_human_required validates the reason, never the request id, before building the path)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_degradation.py:165 (request id f'tool-degraded:{tool_id}:{first cycle}', written at :275 after a three-cycle streak)
.github/workflows/aria-auto-cycle.yml:1428-1468 (both forensic uploads exclude only .aria-state-store/tools/human-required/genesis:*; the comment says the uploader rejects ':')
.github/workflows/aria-agent-executor.yml:1029-1067 (the same two steps and the same single exclusion in the executor lane)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_genesis.py:955-960 (the same defect met once for genesis ids, ORPHAN-714, and fixed for that producer only)
aria-kernel/tests/test_cycle_runtime_status_degraded.py:383 (a test pins the colon spelling of the tool-degraded id; the only artifact-safe pin in the tree is the genesis one)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md tier 1 (make it impossible): the writer of a file name should refuse an id the downstream uploader cannot carry; ORPHAN-714 fixed one producer by hand and left the writer open.
payload.notes: The repo's own ORPHAN-714 note records that the first live colon-named record (genesis) turned the sealed cycle's forensic upload red (run 32090429275) and that GitHub's uploader rejects ':' in paths. self_improvement.propose_self_change mints self-change:<digest> and tool_degradation mints tool-degraded:<tool>:<cycle> into the same human-required directory, and the upload globs exclude only genesis:*. On the first live self_change adjudication, or the first tool degraded for three cycles, the Cache ARIA state tree step fails in both lanes and stays red every later night while the record exists (not verified on the live store; the publish step runs before it, so only forensics and job status are hit). Close condition: record_human_required raises GovernanceError for any request id outside the artifact-safe alphabet, the two producers mint dash ids (self-change-<digest>, tool-degraded-<tool>-<cycle>), and tests pin both producers' record file names without ':' and that record_human_required('a:b') raises (red today); the four legacy genesis:* exclusions stay. Verified at origin/main d716541239.
